docs.text: Pictured Rocks Pictured Rocks National Lakeshore lies on the southern shore of Lake Superior outside of Munising, Michigan. There are miles of trails to hike, beaches to lie on, and of course, Lake Superior to swim in if you dare. The best way to visit the park is to get out on the water.
